title: AIAS Technology Observatory
purpose: Continuously identify and govern world knowledge capable of producing large, sustainable advances in AIAS and materialize safe value at the earliest maturity level.
scope: Authoritative-source registry, observation evidence, relevance and impact scoring, constitutional filtering, opportunity portfolio, immediate-value actions and intelligence release packaging.

requirements.title: Global evidence
requirements.statement: ATO shall register dated, attributable and integrity-protected observations from authoritative world sources.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Constitutional filter
requirements.statement: ATO shall reject opportunities that lack verification, maintainability, compatibility or legal review status.
requirements.rationale: Enforce AEC-000049 without compromising higher obligations.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Giant-step scoring
requirements.statement: ATO shall score relevance, impact, reuse, acceleration, risk and evidence strength reproducibly.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: ECP-F consumption
requirements.statement: ATO shall consume ECP-000001F maturity, findings and KPI evidence when prioritizing opportunities.
requirements.rationale: Create a real feedback consumer for lifecycle evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Immediate value
requirements.statement: ATO shall emit a concrete earliest-maturity action for every accepted opportunity.
requirements.rationale: Execute AEC-000049 as an operational rule.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Intelligence release
requirements.statement: ATO shall generate a versioned portfolio, source ledger, decision log and checksum-protected release.
requirements.rationale: Provide reusable and auditable technology intelligence.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
